create_PoseLocalVisualizer: create a PoseLocalVisualizer instance to visualize pose keypoints and skeletons on images
set_dataset_meta_PoseLocalVisualizer: set dataset metadata on PoseLocalVisualizer to override default visualization colors and skeleton links
add_datasample_PoseLocalVisualizer: add a data sample to PoseLocalVisualizer to draw GT and predicted keypoints with optional heatmaps
draw_instances_kpts_PoseLocalVisualizer: draw keypoints and skeleton links on an image using PoseLocalVisualizer with configurable threshold
draw_instances_bbox_PoseLocalVisualizer: draw bounding boxes with class labels on an image using PoseLocalVisualizer
